## Mancleaver Mantis (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
N Large vermin  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +7 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 57 (6d8+30)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +3, **Will** +4  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft. fly 40 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** 2 claws +10 (1d8+7 plus grab), bite +5 (1d6+3)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** mandibles, sudden strike  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 13, **Con** 20, Int—, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +12 (+16 grapple); **CMD** 23 (27 vs. trip)  
**Feats** LungeB  
**Skills** Climb +15, Fly -5, Perception +6, Stealth +5; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +8 Stealth  


**Special Abilities**


**Mandibles (Ex)** The bite of a mancleaver mantis is a secondary natural attack. When succeeding at a combat maneuver check to maintain grapple, a mancleaver mantis can make a single bite attack against the grappled victim as a free action.  

**Sudden Strike (Ex)** A mancleaver mantis can strike with both claws when making an attack action. This allows the giant mantis to make attacks of opportunity or attack during a surprise round with both claws.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
